title: Multi-Agent Orchestrator Configuration
description: Configuration for the Multi-Agent Orchestrator runtime. Put shared project defaults in orchestrator.config.jsonc and personal overrides in orchestrator.config.local.jsonc.

$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference. Keep this in JSONC configs to enable autocomplete and validation.

default_cli.description: Default worker CLI for coding agents. Built-in choices include kilo, aider, claude, codex, gemini, and opencode; custom names are allowed when cli_templates and cli_health_checks define them.

orchestrator_cli.description: Optional CLI used by the background loop for request arbitration. Use null or omit it to follow default_cli.

cli_templates.description: Command templates used to spawn worker CLIs and invoke the orchestrator CLI. Project entries override built-ins; omitted built-in CLIs keep their defaults.

cli_health_checks.description: Per-CLI install probes used by scripts/preflight.js. Defaults to '<cli> --version' for built-in CLIs.

reviewers.description: Optional read-only plan reviewer CLIs for Phase 1.5. Reviewers critique draft decomposition before worker launch.

max_plan_review_iterations.description: Plan review iteration policy. 'auto' means run at least one reviewer pass when reviewers are configured, then let the caller decide whether another pass is worth it.

default_timeout_mins.description: Default liveness timeout in minutes. If an agent stops emitting logs for this long, the loop treats it as hung.

default_progress_timeout_mins.description: Default progress timeout in minutes. If an active agent produces no code changes for this long, the loop creates a progress-timeout arbitration request.

default_max_restarts.description: Maximum restart attempts per agent before it is marked errored.

orchestrator_failure_threshold.description: Consecutive orchestrator-CLI failures before coord/orchestrator-stalled.flag is written.

poll_min_ms.description: Minimum adaptive polling interval in milliseconds.

poll_max_ms.description: Maximum adaptive polling interval in milliseconds.

launch_dashboard.description: Dashboard auto-launch behavior. 'auto' opens a dashboard terminal on local macOS and skips auto-launch in CI/SSH/non-macOS environments.

launch_review_terminal.description: Whether to open a terminal with the deterministic review summary after all workers finish.

cliTemplate.description: Either a shell string containing {prompt_file}, or a structured argv template that includes a prompt placeholder object.

oneOf.description: Shell template. Use only when shell behavior is intentional; must include {prompt_file}.

args.description: Argument vector. Include { "prompt_file": true } or { "prompt_text": true } exactly once where the prompt should be passed.

cli.description: Reviewer CLI name. Must have matching cli_templates.<cli> and cli_health_checks.<cli> entries.

review_focus.description: What this reviewer should focus on, such as ownership boundaries, sequencing risk, validation gaps, or architecture.

model.description: Optional reviewer-specific model id. Appended using model_flag, defaulting to --model.

model_flag.description: Optional CLI flag used with model, for CLIs that do not use --model.

template_args.description: Optional CLI-specific args appended to the reviewer template.
